Title: LSJ Temptation and Heildelberg castle timing

Messages.Author: Screaming Vermillian
Messages.Body:
Take an action to superiorly tempt a vampire with one blood on it. The
targeted minion's controller controls a heidelberg castle. He wishes to
tap it at the end of the action to move blood onto the newly tempted
vampire, avoiding, for now, the temptation control. But at the end of
the action, I also want to burn the count off of the temptation to take
control of the tempted vampire, before he can tap the castle.

Who wins?

I'm guessing the acting (tempting) methuselah. The effects appear
simultaneous, but acting meth gets first shot at things, right?

Just wondering. Thanks.

~SV

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:


Yes.

Indeed, the Temptation counters can be burned during the action, so
could be done before the acting minion plays, for example, Freak Drive
-- before the window for tapping the castle even comes up.
